title: Register LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver in the manifest
description: Registered exactly like the existing ReminderAlarmReceiver -- not exported, no intent-filter, since it's only ever invoked via this app's own explicit PendingIntent from a notification action.
acceptance_criteria: A new <receiver android:name=".notifications.LogDoseFromNotificationReceiver" android:exported="false" /> is added inside <application>
